top_signals.title: The AI kill switch, explained: 'It's not too little, but it's probably too late'
top_signals.summary: As runaway AI fears reach a crescendo, policymakers and tech leaders are weighing the effectiveness of a magic AI stop button known as a kill switch.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: AI safety debate meets reality at Dreamforce as business leaders say last year's models are enough

top_signals.title: Denmark emerges smiling from Trump-Greenland deal, experts say
top_signals.summary: Commentators have noted that Washington was already able to ramp up its military presence on the island under a 1951 defense pact.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
